AI.title: Claude Code’s Next Era — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
AI.what: Anthropic announced the next era of Claude Code with Opus/Sonnet 5.5, mods, plugins, and projects.
AI.why: It introduces powerful new development tools and extensible workflows directly on the frontier.
AI.impact: Accelerates solo full-stack building and coding workflows.

AI.title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
AI.what: PhoneCLI translates mobile app GUI interactions into clean, callable terminal-style commands.
AI.why: It replaces brittle visual perception loops with fast, ordered, and direct actions for mobile agents.
AI.impact: Enables reliable mobile agent development for voice and UI integration.

AI.title: MCP Error Messages Written for Developers Hurt the Most Capable Agent…
AI.what: Research shows that standard developer-facing MCP error messages severely degrade agent execution.
AI.why: Agents fail when they encounter instructions meant for humans, like opening web pages or running terminal commands.
AI.impact: Highlights how to rewrite tool error messages for robust voice-agent tool use.

Design.title: I Tested Opus 5.5 at Every Effort Level for Animation Design
Design.what: An evaluation of Opus 5.5 across all effort levels for animation design was published.
Design.why: Motion design is critical for modern interfaces and this tests AI capability limits.

Design.title: The next larger context
Design.what: An exploration into designing beyond the interface, product, and prompt was published.
Design.why: AI builders need to understand systemic context when creating ambient voice agents.

Design.title: The strategic designer: navigating the Jevons paradox in the AI age
Design.what: An analysis of the Jevons paradox and strategic design in the AI age was shared.
Design.why: As execution time compresses, design vision and systems thinking become core differentiators.

Voice AI.title: Introducing Eleven v4, our most emotive model
